title: Rabbana Ukva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He and Rabbana Nechemyah were Rav’s daughter’s sons. Both were great leaders of their generation: Chullin 92a identifies them as exalted princes who emerge from Israel.

They were Rav Chisda’s students: Bava Batra 51b has them asking him, “Does the Master leave the great authorities and follow the lesser ones?” In Pesachim 115 and Beitzah 29a, Rav Chisda brought Rabbana Ukva forward to expound.
Sotah 39a reads that Rav Chisda brought Rav Ukva forward; Hyman proposes reading Rabbana Ukva.

notes.text: Ukva and Nechemyah are Rav’s maternal grandsons. Hyman’s correction from Rav Ukva to Rabbana Ukva is preserved as his.
